pt.title: [Imóveis 101 #9] A Avaliação Veio $20 Mil Abaixo — Aqui Está a Lógica Por Trás Desse Número

segments.src: > An appraisal isn't a guess about what someone might pay — it's a documented argument for what a property is most likely worth, built from three independent lines of evidence.
segments.tr: > Uma avaliação não é um palpite sobre quanto alguém pode pagar — é um argumento documentado para o que um imóvel provavelmente vale, construído a partir de três linhas independentes de evidência.

segments.src: Every real estate deal quietly runs on three different numbers that people constantly mix up:
segments.tr: Todo negócio imobiliário funciona silenciosamente em três números diferentes que as pessoas constantemente confundem:

segments.src: - **Cost** — what it takes to build or replace the thing.
segments.tr: - **Custo** — o que é necessário para construir ou substituir a coisa.

segments.src: - **Price** — what one specific buyer actually paid on one specific day.
segments.tr: - **Preço** — o que um comprador específico realmente pagou em um dia específico.

segments.src: - **Value** — what a typical, informed buyer would most likely pay under normal conditions.
segments.tr: - **Valor** — o que um comprador típico e informado provavelmente pagaria em condições normais.

segments.src: An appraiser's job is the third one.
segments.tr: O trabalho de um avaliador é o terceiro.

segments.src: lending, "market value" has a legal definition (from the FIRREA banking rules that most lenders follow): the **most probable price** a property should bring in a competitive and open market, where buyer and seller are each typically motivated, well informed, acting in their own interest, under no duress, with the property exposed for a reasonable time, and with payment in cash or its equivalent — not distorted by unusual seller concessions.
segments.tr: empréstimos, "valor de mercado" tem uma definição legal (das regras de banco FIRREA que a maioria dos credores segue): o **preço mais provável** que um imóvel deve trazer em um mercado competitivo e aberto, onde comprador e vendedor são cada um tipicamente motivados, bem informados, agindo em seu próprio interesse, sem coerção, com o imóvel exposto por um tempo razoável, e com pagamento em dinheiro ou seu equivalente — não distorcido por concessões incomuns do vendedor.

segments.src: Every word there is doing work.
"Typically motivated," not a desperate seller or a buyer who has to live next to their mother.
segments.tr: "Tipicamente motivado", não um vendedor desesperado ou um comprador que tem que morar ao lado de sua mãe.

segments.src: That definition is why an appraisal can legitimately disagree with the price on the contract.
segments.tr: Essa definição é o motivo pelo qual uma avaliação pode legitimamente discordar do preço no contrato.

segments.src: **The principles.** Appraisers reason from a small set of economic ideas.
segments.tr: **Os princípios.** Avaliadores raciocinam a partir de um pequeno conjunto de ideias econômicas.

segments.src: - **Substitution** — a buyer won't pay more for a property than the cost of acquiring an equally desirable substitute. This is the engine underneath all three valuation approaches.
segments.tr: - **Substituição** — um comprador não pagará mais por um imóvel do que o custo de adquirir um substituto igualmente desejável. Este é o motor por trás de todas as três abordagens de avaliação.

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — value is based on the most profitable use that is *legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive*. A 1950s bungalow on a commercially zoned corner may be appraised as land, with the house counted as nearly worthless.
segments.tr: - **Maior e melhor uso** — o valor é baseado no uso mais lucrativo que é *legalmente permissível, fisicamente possível, financeiramente viável e maximamente produtivo*. Um bangalô dos anos 1950 em uma esquina de zona comercial pode ser avaliado como terra, com a casa contada como praticamente sem valor.

segments.src: - **Anticipation** — value reflects expected *future* benefits, not past spending. Nobody pays you back for what you spent; they pay for what they expect to get.
segments.tr: - **Antecipação** — o valor reflete os benefícios futuros esperados, não o gasto passado. Ninguém lhe paga de volta pelo que você gastou; pagam pelo que esperam obter.

segments.src: - **Contribution** — an improvement is worth what it adds to total value, not what it cost. The classic case: a $90,000 kitchen that adds $45,000.
segments.tr: - **Contribuição** — uma melhoria vale o que adiciona ao valor total, não o que custou. O caso clássico: uma cozinha de $90,000 que adiciona $45,000.

segments.src: - **Conformity, change, externalities** — properties do best surrounded by similar properties, nothing stays static, and a new highway ramp or a closed hospital changes value from outside the lot line.
segments.tr: - **Conformidade, mudança, externalidades** — os imóveis se saem melhor cercados por imóveis semelhantes, nada permanece estático, e uma nova rampa de rodovia ou um hospital fechado muda o valor de fora da linha do lote.

segments.src: **The three approaches.** These are three separate roads to the same estimate; each is strongest for a different property type.
segments.tr: **As três abordagens.** Estes são três caminhos separados para a mesma estimativa; cada um é mais forte para um tipo de propriedade diferente.

segments.src: 1. **Sales Comparison Approach.** Find recent sales of similar properties ("comps"), then adjust each comp's *sale price* toward the subject. Rule of thumb: if the comp is better, subtract; if the comp is worse, add. Best for single-family homes and condos, where sales data is thick.
segments.tr: 1. **Abordagem de Comparação de Vendas.** Encontre vendas recentes de imóveis semelhantes ("comps"), depois ajuste o *preço de venda* de cada comp em relação ao imóvel. Regra de ouro: se o comp é melhor, subtraia; se o comp é pior, adicione. Melhor para casas unifamiliares e condomínios, onde os dados de vendas são abundantes.

segments.src: 2. **Cost Approach.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Depreciation comes in three flavors: **physical deterioration** (a 22-year-old roof), **functional obsolescence** (a four-bedroom house with one bathroom), and **external obsolescence** (backing onto a rail yard). Best for new construction, churches, schools, fire stations — things that rarely sell.
segments.tr: 2. **Abordagem de Custo.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Depreciação vem em três tipos: **deterioração física** (um telhado de 22 anos), **obsolescência funcional** (uma casa de quatro quartos com um banheiro), e **obsolescência externa** (voltada para um pátio ferroviário). Melhor para construção nova, igrejas, escolas, estações de bombeiros — coisas que raramente vendem.

segments.src: 3. **Income Capitalization Approach.** For property bought to produce income: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI is rental income minus vacancy and operating expenses — *before* mortgage payments and income taxes. Best for apartments, retail strips, warehouses.
segments.tr: 3. **Abordagem de Capitalização de Renda.** Para imóvel comprado para produzir renda: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI é renda de aluguel menos vacância e despesas operacionais — *antes* de pagamentos de hipoteca e impostos de renda. Melhor para apartamentos, lojas de varejo, armazéns.

segments.src: The final step is **reconciliation**: the appraiser weights the approaches by how good the data was and what the property is, then states a single value.
segments.tr: O último passo é **reconciliação**: o avaliador pondera as abordagens por quão bons foram os dados e o que o imóvel é, depois declara um único valor.

segments.src: It is deliberately *not* an average of the three.
segments.tr: Deliberadamente *não* é uma média dos três.

segments.src: You're under contract on a house in Charlotte, North Carolina at **$425,000**, putting 20% down.
segments.tr: Você está sob contrato em uma casa em Charlotte, Carolina do Norte a **$425,000**, dando 20% de entrada.

segments.src: Your lender orders an appraisal — the bank's own risk check, not a favor to you — and it comes back at **$405,000**.
segments.tr: Seu credor pede uma avaliação — a própria verificação de risco do banco, não um favor para você — e ela volta a **$405,000**.
Aqui está o que o avaliador fez.

segments.src: They pulled three recent nearby sales and adjusted each one toward your house:
segments.tr: Eles puxaram três vendas recentes próximas e ajustaram cada uma em relação à sua casa:

segments.src: comp has a 1-car garage, subject has 2     + 10,000
segments.tr: comp has a 1-car garage, subject has 2     + 10,000

segments.src: comp sold 7 months ago, market rose        +  4,000
segments.tr: comp sold 7 months ago, market rose        +  4,000

segments.src: Three adjusted indications cluster in the $404K–$412K range.
segments.tr: Três indicações ajustadas se agrupam na faixa de $404K–$412K.

segments.src: Nothing supports $425,000, so the reported value is $405,000.
segments.tr: Nada suporta $425,000, então o valor relatado é $405,000.

segments.src: Your lender will size the loan on the **lower of price or appraised value**.
segments.tr: Seu credor dimensionará o empréstimo no **menor entre preço ou valor avaliado**.

segments.src: Your 80% loan is based on $405,000 — about $324,000 — not on $425,000.
segments.tr: Seu empréstimo de 80% é baseado em $405,000 — cerca de $324,000 — não em $425,000.

segments.src: That opens a **$20,000 appraisal gap**, and you have four moves: pay the gap in cash, renegotiate the price with the seller, split the difference, or walk away if your contract has an appraisal contingency.
segments.tr: Isso abre uma **lacuna de avaliação de $20,000**, e você tem quatro movimentos: pagar a lacuna em dinheiro, renegociar o preço com o vendedor, dividir a diferença, ou sair se seu contrato tiver uma contingência de avaliação.

segments.src: There's also a fifth: a **Reconsideration of Value (ROV)**.
segments.tr: Há também um quinto: uma **Reconsideração de Valor (RV)**.

segments.src: Under 2024 federal interagency guidance, lenders must have a process for borrowers to submit better comps or flag factual errors — a wrong square footage, a missed recent sale down the block.
segments.tr: Sob orientação federal interagencial de 2024, os credores devem ter um processo para que os mutuários enviem comps melhores ou sinalizem erros factuais — uma metragem quadrada errada, uma venda recente perdida no bairro.

segments.src: It's not a negotiation over the number; it's a request to re-examine the evidence.
segments.tr: Não é uma negociação sobre o número; é um pedido para re-examinar as evidências.

segments.src: One more distinction worth carrying around: an appraisal is not your county's **assessed value** (a tax figure, often updated on a multi-year cycle), not an agent's **CMA** (a pricing opinion, not a regulated appraisal), and not a **Zestimate** or other AVM (a statistical model that has never seen the inside of the house).
segments.tr: Mais uma distinção que vale a pena considerar: uma avaliação não é o **valor avaliado** do seu condado (uma cifra de imposto, frequentemente atualizada em um ciclo de vários anos), não é um **CMA** de um agente (uma opinião de preço, não uma avaliação regulamentada), e não é uma **Zestimate** ou outro AVM (um modelo estatístico que nunca viu o interior da casa).

segments.tr: 1. A avaliação estima *valor de mercado* — o preço mais provável em condições normais — que é algo diferente do custo e do preço de um comprador.

segments.src: 2. The reasoning rests on principles like substitution, highest and best use, anticipation, and contribution — which is why what you spent never automatically equals what you get.
segments.tr: 2. O raciocínio repousa em princípios como substituição, maior e melhor uso, antecipação e contribuição — razão pela qual o que você gastou nunca se iguala automaticamente ao que você recebe.

segments.src: 3. Three approaches — sales comparison, cost, and income — are run and then reconciled by judgment, not averaged; homes lean on comps, income property leans on `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.
segments.tr: 3. Três abordagens — comparação de vendas, custo e renda — são executadas e depois reconciliadas por julgamento, não por média; casas confiam em comps, imóveis de renda confiam em `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — value is based on the most profitable use that is *legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive*. segments.tr: - **Penggunaan tertinggi dan terbaik** — nilai didasarkan pada penggunaan paling menguntungkan yang *diizinkan secara hukum, secara fisik mungkin, secara finansial layak, dan paling produktif*. segments.src: - **Anticipation** — value reflects expected *future* benefits, not past spending. Nobody pays you back for what you spent; they pay for what they expect to get.

segments.src: - **Conformity, change, externalities** — properties do best surrounded by similar properties, nothing stays static, and a new highway ramp or a closed hospital changes value from outside the lot line.

segments.src: 1. **Sales Comparison Approach.** Find recent sales of similar properties ("comps"), then adjust each comp's *sale price* toward the subject. Rule of thumb: if the comp is better, subtract; if the comp is worse, add. Best for single-family homes and condos, where sales data is thick.
segments.tr: 1. **Pendekatan Perbandingan Penjualan.** Temukan penjualan baru properti serupa ("comps"), kemudian sesuaikan *harga penjualan* setiap comp menuju subjek. Aturan praktis: jika comp lebih baik, kurangi; jika comp lebih buruk, tambahkan. Terbaik untuk rumah keluarga tunggal dan apartemen, di mana data penjualan melimpah.

segments.src: 2. **Cost Approach.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Depreciation comes in three flavors: **physical deterioration** (a 22-year-old roof), **functional obsolescence** (a four-bedroom house with one bathroom), and **external obsolescence** (backing onto a rail yard). Best for new construction, churches, schools, fire stations — things that rarely sell.
segments.tr: 2. **Pendekatan Biaya.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Penyusutan hadir dalam tiga varian: **deteriorasi fisik** (atap berusia 22 tahun), **keusangan fungsional** (rumah empat kamar tidur dengan satu kamar mandi), dan **keusangan eksternal** (tergantung pada pekarangan kereta api). Terbaik untuk konstruksi baru, gereja, sekolah, stasiun pemadam kebakaran — hal-hal yang jarang terjual.

segments.src: 3. **Income Capitalization Approach.** For property bought to produce income: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI is rental income minus vacancy and operating expenses — *before* mortgage payments and income taxes. Best for apartments, retail strips, warehouses.
segments.tr: 3. **Pendekatan Kapitalisasi Pendapatan.** Untuk properti yang dibeli untuk menghasilkan pendapatan: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI adalah pendapatan sewa dikurangi kekosongan dan biaya operasional — *sebelum* pembayaran hipotek dan pajak penghasilan. Terbaik untuk apartemen, strip ritel, gudang.

segments.src: The final step is **reconciliation**: the appraiser weights the approaches by how good the data was and what the property is, then states a single value.
segments.tr: Langkah terakhir adalah **rekonsiliasi**: penilai menimbang pendekatan berdasarkan seberapa baik datanya dan apa propertinya, kemudian menyatakan nilai tunggal.

segments.src: It is deliberately *not* an average of the three.
segments.tr: Ini dengan sengaja *bukan* rata-rata dari ketiganya.

segments.src: You're under contract on a house in Charlotte, North Carolina at **$425,000**, putting 20% down.
segments.tr: Anda menandatangani kontrak pada rumah di Charlotte, North Carolina seharga **$425,000**, menyetor uang muka 20%.

segments.src: Your lender orders an appraisal — the bank's own risk check, not a favor to you — and it comes back at **$405,000**.
segments.tr: Pemberi pinjaman Anda memesan penilaian — pemeriksaan risiko bank sendiri, bukan keuntungan bagi Anda — dan hasilnya **$405,000**.

segments.src: They pulled three recent nearby sales and adjusted each one toward your house:
segments.tr: Mereka menarik tiga penjualan terdekat baru dan menyesuaikan masing-masing menuju rumah Anda:

segments.src: comp has a 1-car garage, subject has 2     + 10,000
segments.tr: comp has a 1-car garage, subject has 2     + 10,000

segments.src: comp sold 7 months ago, market rose        +  4,000
segments.tr: comp sold 7 months ago, market rose        +  4,000

segments.src: Three adjusted indications cluster in the $404K–$412K range.
segments.tr: Tiga indikasi yang disesuaikan berkumpul dalam kisaran $404K–$412K.

segments.src: Nothing supports $425,000, so the reported value is $405,000.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang mendukung $425,000, jadi nilai yang dilaporkan adalah $405,000.

segments.src: Your lender will size the loan on the **lower of price or appraised value**.
segments.tr: Pemberi pinjaman Anda akan menentukan pinjaman berdasarkan **nilai yang lebih rendah antara harga dan nilai penilaian**.

segments.src: Your 80% loan is based on $405,000 — about $324,000 — not on $425,000.
segments.tr: Pinjaman 80% Anda didasarkan pada $405,000 — sekitar $324,000 — bukan pada $425,000.

segments.src: That opens a **$20,000 appraisal gap**, and you have four moves: pay the gap in cash, renegotiate the price with the seller, split the difference, or walk away if your contract has an appraisal contingency.
segments.tr: Itu membuka **celah penilaian $20,000**, dan Anda memiliki empat pilihan: membayar celah secara tunai, merundingkan ulang harga dengan penjual, membagi perbedaannya, atau membatalkan jika kontrak Anda memiliki klausul kontingensi penilaian.

segments.src: There's also a fifth: a **Reconsideration of Value (ROV)**.
segments.tr: Ada juga yang kelima: **Pertimbangan Ulang Nilai (ROV)**.

segments.src: Under 2024 federal interagency guidance, lenders must have a process for borrowers to submit better comps or flag factual errors — a wrong square footage, a missed recent sale down the block.
segments.tr: Menurut panduan interageni federal 2024, pemberi pinjaman harus memiliki proses bagi peminjam untuk mengirimkan comps yang lebih baik atau menandai kesalahan faktual — luas persegi yang salah, penjualan baru di sekitar yang terlewat.

segments.src: It's not a negotiation over the number; it's a request to re-examine the evidence.
segments.tr: Ini bukan negosiasi tentang angka; ini adalah permintaan untuk menguji ulang bukti.

segments.src: One more distinction worth carrying around: an appraisal is not your county's **assessed value** (a tax figure, often updated on a multi-year cycle), not an agent's **CMA** (a pricing opinion, not a regulated appraisal), and not a **Zestimate** or other AVM (a statistical model that has never seen the inside of the house).
segments.tr: Satu perbedaan lagi yang perlu diperhatikan: penilaian bukan **nilai taksir pajak** kabupaten Anda (angka pajak, sering diperbarui dalam siklus multi-tahun), bukan **CMA** agen (pendapat harga, bukan penilaian yang diatur), dan bukan **Zestimate** atau AVM lainnya (model statistik yang tidak pernah melihat rumah dari dalam).

segments.src: 1. Appraisal estimates *market value* — the most probable price under normal conditions — which is a different thing from cost and from one buyer's price.
segments.tr: 1. Penilaian memperkirakan *nilai pasar* — harga paling mungkin dalam kondisi normal — yang berbeda dari biaya dan harga satu pembeli.

segments.src: 2. The reasoning rests on principles like substitution, highest and best use, anticipation, and contribution — which is why what you spent never automatically equals what you get.
segments.tr: 2. Penalaran didasarkan pada prinsip-prinsip seperti substitusi, penggunaan tertinggi dan terbaik, antisipasi, dan kontribusi — itulah sebabnya apa yang Anda keluarkan tidak pernah secara otomatis sama dengan apa yang Anda dapatkan.

segments.src: 3. Three approaches — sales comparison, cost, and income — are run and then reconciled by judgment, not averaged; homes lean on comps, income property leans on `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.
segments.tr: 3. Tiga pendekatan — perbandingan penjualan, biaya, dan pendapatan — dijalankan dan kemudian direkonsiliasi dengan penilaian, bukan rata-rata; rumah bergantung pada comps, properti penghasilan bergantung pada `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.

segments.src: **1.** A small apartment building generates $48,000 in net operating income.
segments.tr: **1.** Sebuah gedung apartemen kecil menghasilkan $48,000 dalam pendapatan operasional bersih.

segments.src: Comparable buildings in the area trade at a 6% capitalization rate.
segments.tr: Bangunan yang sebanding di wilayah tersebut diperdagangkan dengan tingkat kapitalisasi 6%.

segments.src: What value does the income approach indicate?
segments.tr: Nilai apa yang ditunjukkan pendekatan pendapatan?

segments.src: **2.** You spend $90,000 on a luxury kitchen; the house then appraises only $45,000 higher.
segments.tr: **2.** Anda menghabiskan $90,000 untuk dapur mewah; rumah kemudian dinilai hanya $45,000 lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Which appraisal principle best explains this?
segments.tr: Prinsip penilaian mana yang paling menjelaskan ini?

segments.src: **3.** O/X — If a home appraises for $405,000 but you're under contract at $425,000, the lender will simply base your loan on the $425,000 contract price because that's what you agreed to pay.
segments.tr: **3.** O/X — Jika rumah dinilai $405,000 tetapi Anda menandatangani kontrak pada $425,000, pemberi pinjaman hanya akan mendasarkan pinjaman Anda pada harga kontrak $425,000 karena itu yang Anda setujui untuk dibayarkan.

segments.src: - **Market value** — The most probable price a property should bring in an open, competitive market with both parties informed, unpressured, and given reasonable exposure time.
segments.tr: - **Nilai pasar** — Harga paling mungkin yang harus dibawa properti di pasar terbuka dan kompetitif dengan kedua belah pihak terinformasi, tidak tertekan, dan diberikan waktu paparan yang wajar.

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — The use of a property that is legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive; the baseline assumption for any appraisal.
segments.tr: - **Penggunaan tertinggi dan terbaik** — Penggunaan properti yang diizinkan secara hukum, secara fisik mungkin, secara finansial layak, dan paling produktif; asumsi dasar untuk penilaian apa pun.

segments.src: - **Comparable (comp)** — A recently sold, similar property whose sale price is adjusted up or down toward the subject property to indicate the subject's value.
segments.tr: - **Sebanding (comp)** — Properti serupa yang baru saja terjual yang harga penjualannya disesuaikan naik atau turun menuju properti subjek untuk menunjukkan nilai subjek.

segments.src: - **Capitalization rate** — The ratio of a property's net operating income to its value (`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`), used to convert income into a value estimate.
segments.tr: - **Tingkat kapitalisasi** — Rasio pendapatan operasional bersih properti terhadap nilainya (`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`), digunakan untuk mengubah pendapatan menjadi perkiraan nilai.

segments.src: - **Accrued depreciation** — Total loss in value of the improvements from physical deterioration, functional obsolescence, and external obsolescence, subtracted in the cost approach.
segments.tr: - **Penyusutan terkumpul** — Total kerugian nilai perbaikan dari deteriorasi fisik, keusangan fungsional, dan keusangan eksternal, dikurangkan dalam pendekatan biaya.

segments.src: - **Reconciliation** — The final step where the appraiser weighs the value indications from the three approaches and states a single supported conclusion — not a mathematical average.
segments.tr: - **Rekonsiliasi** — Langkah terakhir di mana penilai menimbang indikasi nilai dari tiga pendekatan dan menyatakan kesimpulan tunggal yang didukung — bukan rata-rata matematika.

segments.src: Direct capitalization divides NOI by the cap rate; note that NOI is measured before mortgage payments.
segments.tr: Kapitalisasi langsung membagi NOI dengan tingkat cap; perhatikan bahwa NOI diukur sebelum pembayaran hipotek.

segments.src: **2 — B.** The principle of contribution says an improvement is worth what it adds to overall value, not what it cost — over-improving relative to the neighborhood rarely returns dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: **2 — B.** Prinsip kontribusi mengatakan bahwa peningkatan bernilai apa yang ditambahkannya ke nilai keseluruhan, bukan apa biayanya — meningkatkan diri relatif terhadap lingkungan jarang memberikan nilai demi nilai.

segments.src: **3 — X (False).** Lenders size the loan against the **lower** of appraised value or contract price, which creates the $20,000 appraisal gap the buyer must cover in cash, renegotiate, or exit via an appraisal contingency.*
segments.tr: **3 — X (Salah).** Pemberi pinjaman mengukur pinjaman terhadap **nilai yang lebih rendah** dari nilai penilaian atau harga kontrak, yang menciptakan celah penilaian $20,000 yang harus ditanggung pembeli secara tunai, dirundingkan ulang, atau keluar melalui klausul kontingensi penilaian.*

ja.title: [不動産入門101 #9] 鑑定が$20,000低く出た — その数字の裏にあるロジック

segments.src: > An appraisal isn't a guess about what someone might pay — it's a documented argument for what a property is most likely worth, built from three independent lines of evidence.
segments.tr: > 鑑定とは、誰かが支払うかもしれない金額の推測ではなく、3つの独立した根拠から構成された、不動産がおそらく最も価値がある金額についての立証済み主張です。

segments.src: Every real estate deal quietly runs on three different numbers that people constantly mix up:
segments.tr: すべての不動産取引は、人々が常に混同する3つの異なる数字で静かに進行しています：

segments.src: - **Cost** — what it takes to build or replace the thing.
segments.tr: - **コスト** — ものを建設または置き換えるのに必要な金額。

segments.src: - **Price** — what one specific buyer actually paid on one specific day.
segments.tr: - **価格** — 特定の買い手が特定の日に実際に支払った金額。

segments.src: - **Value** — what a typical, informed buyer would most likely pay under normal conditions.
segments.tr: - **価値** — 典型的で情報通の買い手が通常の条件下でおそらく支払うであろう金額。

segments.src: An appraiser's job is the third one.
segments.tr: 鑑定士の仕事は3番目のものです。

segments.src: lending, "market value" has a legal definition (from the FIRREA banking rules that most lenders follow): the **most probable price** a property should bring in a competitive and open market, where buyer and seller are each typically motivated, well informed, acting in their own interest, under no duress, with the property exposed for a reasonable time, and with payment in cash or its equivalent — not distorted by unusual seller concessions.
segments.tr: 融資において、「市場価値」は法的定義を持ちます（ほとんどの貸し手が従うFIRREA銀行規則から）：競争的でオープンな市場で不動産がもたらすべき**最も可能性の高い価格**。買い手と売り手はそれぞれ通常の動機を持ち、十分に情報を持ち、自身の利益に従って行動し、強制下にはなく、不動産が合理的な期間にわたって公開されており、現金またはそれに相当する支払いであり、通常でない売り手の譲歩によって歪められていません。

segments.src: Every word there is doing work.
segments.tr: そこのすべての単語が機能しています。
「最も可能性の高い」、最高ではなく。

segments.src: "Typically motivated," not a desperate seller or a buyer who has to live next to their mother.
segments.tr: 「通常は動機付けられた」、絶望的な売り手や母親の隣に住む必要がある買い手ではなく。

segments.src: That definition is why an appraisal can legitimately disagree with the price on the contract.
segments.tr: その定義が、鑑定が契約上の価格に正当に異なることができる理由です。

segments.src: **The principles.** Appraisers reason from a small set of economic ideas.
segments.tr: **原則。** 鑑定士は少数の経済的考え方から推論します。

segments.src: - **Substitution** — a buyer won't pay more for a property than the cost of acquiring an equally desirable substitute. This is the engine underneath all three valuation approaches.
segments.tr: - **代替原則** — 買い手は同等に望ましい代替品を取得するコストよりも多く不動産に支払うことはありません。これは3つの評価アプローチすべての基礎にあるエンジンです。

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — value is based on the most profitable use that is *legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive*. A 1950s bungalow on a commercially zoned corner may be appraised as land, with the house counted as nearly worthless.
segments.tr: - **最適使用原則** — 価値は*法的に許可され、物理的に可能で、経済的に実行可能で、最大限に生産的である*最も収益性の高い使用に基づいています。商業的にゾーニングされたコーナーにある1950年代のバンガローは、土地として評価される可能性があり、家はほぼ無価値と数えられます。

segments.src: - **Anticipation** — value reflects expected *future* benefits, not past spending. Nobody pays you back for what you spent; they pay for what they expect to get.
segments.tr: - **予期原則** — 価値は過去の支出ではなく、予想される*将来の*利益を反映しています。誰もあなたが費やしたものに対してあなたに返済しません。彼らはあなたが得ることを期待するもののために支払います。

segments.src: - **Contribution** — an improvement is worth what it adds to total value, not what it cost. The classic case: a $90,000 kitchen that adds $45,000.
segments.tr: - **寄与原則** — 改善はそれがコストするのではなく、総価値に追加するものの価値があります。古典的なケース：$90,000のキッチンが$45,000を追加します。

segments.src: - **Conformity, change, externalities** — properties do best surrounded by similar properties, nothing stays static, and a new highway ramp or a closed hospital changes value from outside the lot line.
segments.tr: - **適合原則、変化、外部性** — 不動産は類似の不動産に囲まれたときに最良の結果を出し、何も静止したままではなく、新しい高速道路ランプまたは閉鎖された病院は敷地外から価値を変えます。

segments.src: **The three approaches.** These are three separate roads to the same estimate; each is strongest for a different property type.
segments.tr: **3つのアプローチ。** これらは同じ推定値への3つの別々の道です。それぞれは異なるプロパティタイプに対して最も強力です。

segments.src: 1. **Sales Comparison Approach.** Find recent sales of similar properties ("comps"), then adjust each comp's *sale price* toward the subject. Rule of thumb: if the comp is better, subtract; if the comp is worse, add. Best for single-family homes and condos, where sales data is thick.
segments.tr: 1. **比較法。** 類似した不動産の最近の売却（「コンプ」）を見つけ、各コンプの*売却価格*を対象に向かって調整します。経験則：コンプがより良い場合は減算します。コンプがより悪い場合は追加します。販売データが豊富な一戸建てと共有物件に最適です。

segments.src: 2. **Cost Approach.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Depreciation comes in three flavors: **physical deterioration** (a 22-year-old roof), **functional obsolescence** (a four-bedroom house with one bathroom), and **external obsolescence** (backing onto a rail yard). Best for new construction, churches, schools, fire stations — things that rarely sell.
segments.tr: 2. **原価法。** `価値 = 土地価値 + (新規建設コスト − 累積減価償却)`。減価償却には3つの種類があります：**物理的劣化**（22年目の屋根）、**機能的陳腐化**（バスルームが1つある4寝室の家）、および**外部的陳腐化**（鉄道ヤードに隣接）。新築、教会、学校、消防署などほとんど売却されないものに最適です。

segments.src: 3. **Income Capitalization Approach.** For property bought to produce income: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI is rental income minus vacancy and operating expenses — *before* mortgage payments and income taxes. Best for apartments, retail strips, warehouses.
segments.tr: 3. **収益還元法。** 収入を生み出すために購入された不動産の場合：`価値 = 純営業利益 ÷ 資本化率`。NOIは家賃収入から空室と運営費用を差し引いたもの — *前に*住宅ローン支払いと所得税。アパート、小売りストリップ、倉庫に最適です。

segments.src: The final step is **reconciliation**: the appraiser weights the approaches by how good the data was and what the property is, then states a single value.
segments.tr: 最後のステップは**調整**です：鑑定士はデータの品質と不動産が何であるかによってアプローチに重み付けし、単一の価値を述べます。

segments.src: It is deliberately *not* an average of the three.
segments.tr: それは意図的に3つの*平均ではありません*。

segments.src: 2. The reasoning rests on principles like substitution, highest and best use, anticipation, and contribution — which is why what you spent never automatically equals what you get.
segments.tr: 2. 推論は代替原則、最適使用原則、予期原則、寄与原則などの原則に基づいています — これがあなたが費やしたものが決してあなたが得るものに自動的に等しくない理由です。

segments.src: 3. Three approaches — sales comparison, cost, and income — are run and then reconciled by judgment, not averaged; homes lean on comps, income property leans on `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.
segments.tr: 3. 3つのアプローチ — 比較法、原価法、収益還元法 — が実行されてから判断によって調整されます。平均されるのではなく；住宅はコンプに頼り、収入不動産は`価値 = NOI ÷ 資本化率`に頼ります。

segments.tr: **1.** 小さなアパートビルは純営業利益で$48,000を生成します。

segments.src: Comparable buildings in the area trade at a 6% capitalization rate.
segments.tr: この地域の比較可能なビルは6%の資本化率で取引されています。

segments.src: What value does the income approach indicate?
segments.tr: 収益還元法はどの価値を示していますか？

segments.src: **2.** You spend $90,000 on a luxury kitchen; the house then appraises only $45,000 higher.
segments.tr: **2.** 高級キッチンに$90,000を費やします；家はその後$45,000だけ高くなります。

segments.src: Which appraisal principle best explains this?
segments.tr: どの鑑定原則がこれを最もよく説明していますか？

segments.src: **3.** O/X — If a home appraises for $405,000 but you're under contract at $425,000, the lender will simply base your loan on the $425,000 contract price because that's what you agreed to pay.
segments.tr: **3.** 〇/× — 家が$405,000で鑑定されるが、$425,000で契約している場合、貸し手は単に$425,000の契約価格を基準にローンを基づかせます。なぜなら、それはあなたが支払うことに同意したものだからです。

segments.src: - **Market value** — The most probable price a property should bring in an open, competitive market with both parties informed, unpressured, and given reasonable exposure time.
segments.tr: - **市場価値** — 両当事者が情報通で、圧力を受けず、合理的な公開期間を与えられたオープンで競争的な市場で、不動産がもたらすべき最も可能性の高い価格。

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — The use of a property that is legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive; the baseline assumption for any appraisal.
segments.tr: - **最適使用原則** — 法的に許可され、物理的に可能で、経済的に実行可能で、最大限に生産的な不動産の使用；任意の鑑定のための基本的な仮定。

segments.src: - **Comparable (comp)** — A recently sold, similar property whose sale price is adjusted up or down toward the subject property to indicate the subject's value.
segments.tr: - **比較対象物件（コンプ）** — 最近売却された、類似の不動産。その売却価格は対象不動産に向かって上下に調整されて、対象の価値を示します。

segments.src: - **Capitalization rate** — The ratio of a property's net operating income to its value (`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`), used to convert income into a value estimate.
segments.tr: - **資本化率** — 不動産の純営業利益のその価値に対する比率（`資本化率 = NOI ÷ 価値`）、収入を価値推定に変換するために使用されます。

segments.src: - **Accrued depreciation** — Total loss in value of the improvements from physical deterioration, functional obsolescence, and external obsolescence, subtracted in the cost approach.
segments.tr: - **累積減価償却** — 物理的劣化、機能的陳腐化、および外部的陳腐化からの改善の価値の総損失。原価法で差し引かれます。

segments.src: - **Reconciliation** — The final step where the appraiser weighs the value indications from the three approaches and states a single supported conclusion — not a mathematical average.
segments.tr: - **調整** — 鑑定士が3つのアプローチからの価値指標に重み付けし、単一の支持された結論を述べる最終ステップ — 数学的平均ではなく。

segments.src: Direct capitalization divides NOI by the cap rate; note that NOI is measured before mortgage payments.
segments.tr: 直接資本化はNOIを資本化率で割ります；NOIは住宅ローン支払いの前に測定されることに注意してください。

segments.src: **2 — B.** The principle of contribution says an improvement is worth what it adds to overall value, not what it cost — over-improving relative to the neighborhood rarely returns dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: **2 — B.** 寄与原則は、改善はそれがコストするのではなく、総価値に追加するものの価値があると言っています — 近所に対する過度な改善はドルドルを返すことはめったにありません。

segments.src: **3 — X (False).** Lenders size the loan against the **lower** of appraised value or contract price, which creates the $20,000 appraisal gap the buyer must cover in cash, renegotiate, or exit via an appraisal contingency.*
segments.tr: **3 — × (偽)。** 貸し手は鑑定価値または契約価格の**低い方**に対してローンをサイズします。これにより、買い手が現金で支払う必要がある$20,000の鑑定ギャップが生じます。再交渉するか、鑑定条項を通じて終了します。*

de.title: [Immobilien 101 #9] Die Bewertung Fiel 20.000 US-Dollar Zu Niedrig Aus — So Funktioniert Die Logik Dahinter

segments.src: > An appraisal isn't a guess about what someone might pay — it's a documented argument for what a property is most likely worth, built from three independent lines of evidence.
segments.tr: > Eine Bewertung ist keine Vermutung darüber, was jemand zahlen könnte – sie ist ein dokumentiertes Argument dafür, was eine Immobilie höchstwahrscheinlich wert ist, basierend auf drei unabhängigen Beweislinien.

segments.src: Every real estate deal quietly runs on three different numbers that people constantly mix up:
segments.tr: Jedes Immobiliengeschäft läuft stillschweigend auf drei verschiedenen Zahlen ab, die Menschen ständig verwechseln:

segments.src: - **Cost** — what it takes to build or replace the thing.
segments.tr: - **Kosten** — was erforderlich ist, um etwas zu bauen oder zu ersetzen.

segments.src: - **Price** — what one specific buyer actually paid on one specific day.
segments.tr: - **Preis** — was ein bestimmter Käufer an einem bestimmten Tag tatsächlich zahlte.

segments.src: - **Value** — what a typical, informed buyer would most likely pay under normal conditions.
segments.tr: - **Wert** — was ein typischer, informierter Käufer unter normalen Bedingungen höchstwahrscheinlich zahlen würde.

segments.src: An appraiser's job is the third one.
segments.tr: Ein Bewerter kümmert sich um die dritte.

segments.src: lending, "market value" has a legal definition (from the FIRREA banking rules that most lenders follow): the **most probable price** a property should bring in a competitive and open market, where buyer and seller are each typically motivated, well informed, acting in their own interest, under no duress, with the property exposed for a reasonable time, and with payment in cash or its equivalent — not distorted by unusual seller concessions.
segments.tr: wird bei Kreditvergaben der Begriff „Marktwert" legal definiert (nach den FIRREA-Bankregeln, die die meisten Kreditgeber befolgen): der **wahrscheinlichste Preis**, den eine Immobilie auf einem wettbewerbsfähigen und offenen Markt erzielen sollte, wo Käufer und Verkäufer jeweils typischerweise motiviert, gut informiert, im eigenen Interesse handeln, ohne Zwang, wobei die Immobilie für eine angemessene Zeit exponiert ist und mit einer Zahlung in bar oder deren Äquivalent – nicht verzerrt durch ungewöhnliche Verkäuferzugeständnisse.

segments.src: Every word there is doing work.
"Typically motivated," not a desperate seller or a buyer who has to live next to their mother.
segments.tr: „Typischerweise motiviert" nicht ein verzweifelter Verkäufer oder ein Käufer, der neben seiner Mutter leben muss.

segments.src: That definition is why an appraisal can legitimately disagree with the price on the contract.
segments.tr: Diese Definition ist der Grund, warum eine Bewertung legitim mit dem Preis im Vertrag nicht übereinstimmen kann.

segments.src: **The principles.** Appraisers reason from a small set of economic ideas.
segments.tr: **Die Grundsätze.** Bewerter argumentieren ausgehend von einer kleinen Menge ökonomischer Grundideen.

segments.src: - **Substitution** — a buyer won't pay more for a property than the cost of acquiring an equally desirable substitute. This is the engine underneath all three valuation approaches.
segments.tr: - **Substitution** — ein Käufer wird nicht mehr für eine Immobilie zahlen als die Kosten für den Erwerb eines gleich attraktiven Ersatzes. Dies ist der Motor hinter allen drei Bewertungsansätzen.

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — value is based on the most profitable use that is *legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive*. A 1950s bungalow on a commercially zoned corner may be appraised as land, with the house counted as nearly worthless.
segments.tr: - **Höchste und beste Nutzung** — der Wert basiert auf der rentabelsten Nutzung, die *rechtlich zulässig, physisch möglich, finanziell durchführbar und maximal produktiv* ist. Ein Bungalow aus den 1950er Jahren auf einer kommerziell genutzten Ecke kann als Land bewertet werden, wobei das Haus als fast wertlos gezählt wird.

segments.src: - **Anticipation** — value reflects expected *future* benefits, not past spending. Nobody pays you back for what you spent; they pay for what they expect to get.
segments.tr: - **Antizipation** — der Wert spiegelt erwartete *zukünftige* Vorteile wider, nicht frühere Ausgaben. Niemand zahlt dir zurück, was du ausgegeben hast; sie zahlen für das, was sie erwarten zu bekommen.

segments.src: - **Contribution** — an improvement is worth what it adds to total value, not what it cost. The classic case: a $90,000 kitchen that adds $45,000.
segments.tr: - **Beitrag** — eine Verbesserung ist wert, was sie zum Gesamtwert hinzufügt, nicht was sie kostete. Der klassische Fall: eine $90,000-Küche, die $45,000 hinzufügt.

segments.src: - **Conformity, change, externalities** — properties do best surrounded by similar properties, nothing stays static, and a new highway ramp or a closed hospital changes value from outside the lot line.
segments.tr: - **Konformität, Wandel, Externalitäten** — Immobilien funktionieren am besten umgeben von ähnlichen Immobilien, nichts bleibt statisch, und eine neue Autobahnauffahrt oder ein geschlossenes Krankenhaus ändert den Wert von außerhalb der Grundstücksgrenze.

segments.src: **The three approaches.** These are three separate roads to the same estimate; each is strongest for a different property type.
segments.tr: **Die drei Ansätze.** Dies sind drei separate Wege zur gleichen Schätzung; jeder ist am stärksten für einen anderen Immobilientyp.

segments.src: 1. **Sales Comparison Approach.** Find recent sales of similar properties ("comps"), then adjust each comp's *sale price* toward the subject. Rule of thumb: if the comp is better, subtract; if the comp is worse, add. Best for single-family homes and condos, where sales data is thick.
segments.tr: 1. **Vergleichswertverfahren.** Finde aktuelle Verkäufe ähnlicher Immobilien („Vergleichsobjekte"), passe dann den *Verkaufspreis* jedes Vergleichsobjektes zum Subjekt an. Faustregel: wenn das Vergleichsobjekt besser ist, subtrahiere; wenn das Vergleichsobjekt schlechter ist, addiere. Am besten für Einfamilienhäuser und Eigentumswohnungen, wo Verkaufsdaten reichlich vorhanden sind.

segments.src: 2. **Cost Approach.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Depreciation comes in three flavors: **physical deterioration** (a 22-year-old roof), **functional obsolescence** (a four-bedroom house with one bathroom), and **external obsolescence** (backing onto a rail yard). Best for new construction, churches, schools, fire stations — things that rarely sell.
segments.tr: 2. **Kostenansatz.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Die Wertminderung kommt in drei Arten vor: **physikalischer Verschleiß** (ein 22 Jahre altes Dach), **funktionale Veralterung** (ein Haus mit vier Schlafzimmern und einem Badezimmer) und **externe Veralterung** (Rückseite auf einen Rangierbahnhof). Am besten für Neubauten, Kirchen, Schulen, Feuerwehrwachen – Dinge, die selten verkauft werden.

segments.src: 3. **Income Capitalization Approach.** For property bought to produce income: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI is rental income minus vacancy and operating expenses — *before* mortgage payments and income taxes. Best for apartments, retail strips, warehouses.
segments.tr: 3. **Ertragswertverfahren.** Für eine Immobilie, die erworben wurde, um Einkommen zu generieren: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI ist Mieteinnahmen minus Leerstand und Betriebskosten — *vor* Hypothekenzahlungen und Einkommensteuern. Am besten für Wohnungen, Einzelhandelstreifen, Lagerhallen.

segments.src: The final step is **reconciliation**: the appraiser weights the approaches by how good the data was and what the property is, then states a single value.
segments.tr: Der letzte Schritt ist **Abstimmung**: Der Bewerter gewichtet die Ansätze danach, wie gut die Daten waren und was die Immobilie ist, und teilt dann einen einzelnen Wert mit.

segments.src: It is deliberately *not* an average of the three.
segments.tr: Es ist bewusst *kein* Durchschnitt der drei.

segments.src: You're under contract on a house in Charlotte, North Carolina at **$425,000**, putting 20% down.
segments.tr: Du hast einen Vertrag auf ein Haus in Charlotte, North Carolina zu **$425,000**, mit 20% Anzahlung.

segments.src: Your lender orders an appraisal — the bank's own risk check, not a favor to you — and it comes back at **$405,000**.
segments.tr: Dein Kreditgeber fordert eine Bewertung an – die eigene Risikokontrolle der Bank, keine Gefälligkeit für dich – und sie kommt mit **$405,000** zurück.
Das ist, was der Bewerter tat.

segments.src: They pulled three recent nearby sales and adjusted each one toward your house:
segments.tr: Er zog drei aktuelle nahe gelegene Verkäufe heran und passte jeden zu deinem Haus an:

segments.src: comp has a 1-car garage, subject has 2     + 10,000
segments.tr: comp has a 1-car garage, subject has 2     + 10,000

segments.src: comp sold 7 months ago, market rose        +  4,000
segments.tr: comp sold 7 months ago, market rose        +  4,000

segments.src: Three adjusted indications cluster in the $404K–$412K range.
segments.tr: Drei angepasste Hinweise gruppieren sich im Bereich $404K–$412K.

segments.src: Nothing supports $425,000, so the reported value is $405,000.
segments.tr: Nichts unterstützt $425,000, daher ist der gemeldete Wert $405,000.

segments.src: Your lender will size the loan on the **lower of price or appraised value**.
segments.tr: Dein Kreditgeber wird das Darlehen auf dem **Mindereren des Preises oder des Schätzwertes** bemessen.

segments.src: Your 80% loan is based on $405,000 — about $324,000 — not on $425,000.
segments.tr: Dein 80%-Darlehen basiert auf $405,000 — etwa $324,000 — nicht auf $425,000.

segments.src: That opens a **$20,000 appraisal gap**, and you have four moves: pay the gap in cash, renegotiate the price with the seller, split the difference, or walk away if your contract has an appraisal contingency.
segments.tr: Das eröffnet eine **$20,000 Bewertungslücke**, und du hast vier Optionen: zahle die Lücke in bar, verhandle den Preis mit dem Verkäufer neu, teile den Unterschied, oder gehe weg, wenn dein Vertrag eine Bewertungskonditionalität hat.

segments.src: There's also a fifth: a **Reconsideration of Value (ROV)**.
segments.tr: Es gibt auch eine fünfte: eine **Überprüfung des Wertes (ROV)**.

segments.src: Under 2024 federal interagency guidance, lenders must have a process for borrowers to submit better comps or flag factual errors — a wrong square footage, a missed recent sale down the block.
segments.tr: Nach 2024 föderaler behördenübergreifender Anleitung müssen Kreditgeber einen Prozess haben, damit Kreditnehmer bessere Vergleichsobjekte einreichen oder tatsächliche Fehler kennzeichnen können – eine falsche Quadratmeterzahl, ein verpasster kürzlicher Verkauf um die Ecke.

segments.src: It's not a negotiation over the number; it's a request to re-examine the evidence.
segments.tr: Es ist keine Verhandlung über die Zahl; es ist eine Anfrage, die Beweise erneut zu prüfen.

segments.src: One more distinction worth carrying around: an appraisal is not your county's **assessed value** (a tax figure, often updated on a multi-year cycle), not an agent's **CMA** (a pricing opinion, not a regulated appraisal), and not a **Zestimate** or other AVM (a statistical model that has never seen the inside of the house).
segments.tr: Noch eine Unterscheidung, die es wert ist zu beachten: eine Bewertung ist nicht der **geschätzte Wert** deines Landkreises (eine Steuerzahl, oft in einem mehrjährigen Zyklus aktualisiert), nicht die **CMA** eines Maklers (eine Preismeinung, keine regulierte Bewertung), und nicht a **Zestimate** oder ein anderes AVM (ein statistisches Modell, das das Innere des Hauses nie gesehen hat).

segments.src: 1. Appraisal estimates *market value* — the most probable price under normal conditions — which is a different thing from cost and from one buyer's price.
segments.tr: 1. Bewertung schätzt *Marktwert* — der wahrscheinlichste Preis unter normalen Bedingungen — was etwas anderes ist als Kosten und als der Preis eines Käufers.

segments.src: 2. The reasoning rests on principles like substitution, highest and best use, anticipation, and contribution — which is why what you spent never automatically equals what you get.
segments.tr: 2. Die Begründung basiert auf Grundsätzen wie Substitution, höchste und beste Nutzung, Antizipation und Beitrag — deshalb ist das, was du ausgibst, niemals automatisch gleich dem, was du bekommst.

segments.src: 3. Three approaches — sales comparison, cost, and income — are run and then reconciled by judgment, not averaged; homes lean on comps, income property leans on `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.
segments.tr: 3. Drei Ansätze — Vergleichswertverfahren, Kosten und Ertrag — werden ausgeführt und dann durch Urteil abgestimmt, nicht gemittelt; Häuser stützen sich auf Vergleichsobjekte, Einkommensimmobilien stützen sich auf `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.

segments.src: **1.** A small apartment building generates $48,000 in net operating income.
segments.tr: **1.** Ein kleines Mehrfamilienhaus generiert $48,000 an Nettobetriebseinkommen.

segments.src: Comparable buildings in the area trade at a 6% capitalization rate.
segments.tr: Vergleichbare Gebäude in der Gegend werden mit einer 6%-Kapitalisierungsquote gehandelt.

segments.src: What value does the income approach indicate?
segments.tr: Welchen Wert zeigt der Ertrag-Ansatz an?

segments.src: **2.** You spend $90,000 on a luxury kitchen; the house then appraises only $45,000 higher.
segments.tr: **2.** Du gibst $90,000 für eine Luxusküche aus; das Haus wird dann nur $45,000 höher bewertet.

segments.src: Which appraisal principle best explains this?
segments.tr: Welches Bewertungsgrundsatz erklärt dies am besten?

segments.src: **3.** O/X — If a home appraises for $405,000 but you're under contract at $425,000, the lender will simply base your loan on the $425,000 contract price because that's what you agreed to pay.
segments.tr: **3.** O/X — Wenn ein Haus mit $405,000 bewertet wird, aber du unter Vertrag bei $425,000 stehst, wird der Kreditgeber dein Darlehen einfach auf dem $425,000-Vertragspreis basieren, weil das das ist, worauf du dich geeinigt hast.

segments.src: - **Market value** — The most probable price a property should bring in an open, competitive market with both parties informed, unpressured, and given reasonable exposure time.
segments.tr: - **Marktwert** — Der wahrscheinlichste Preis, den eine Immobilie auf einem offenen, wettbewerbsfähigen Markt mit beiden informierten Parteien, ohne Druck und mit angemessener Expositionszeit erzielen sollte.

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — The use of a property that is legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive; the baseline assumption for any appraisal.
segments.tr: - **Höchste und beste Nutzung** — Die Nutzung einer Immobilie, die rechtlich zulässig, physisch möglich, finanziell durchführbar und maximal produktiv ist; die Grundannahme für jede Bewertung.

segments.src: - **Comparable (comp)** — A recently sold, similar property whose sale price is adjusted up or down toward the subject property to indicate the subject's value.
segments.tr: - **Vergleichsobjekt (Vergleich)** — Eine kürzlich verkaufte, ähnliche Immobilie, deren Verkaufspreis nach oben oder unten zum Subjekt angepasst wird, um den Wert des Subjekts anzuzeigen.

segments.src: - **Capitalization rate** — The ratio of a property's net operating income to its value (`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`), used to convert income into a value estimate.
segments.tr: - **Kapitalisierungsquote** — Das Verhältnis der Nettobetriebseinkünfte einer Immobilie zu ihrem Wert (`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`), das verwendet wird, um Einkommen in eine Wertschätzung umzuwandeln.

segments.src: - **Accrued depreciation** — Total loss in value of the improvements from physical deterioration, functional obsolescence, and external obsolescence, subtracted in the cost approach.
segments.tr: - **Kumulierte Wertminderung** — Gesamtverlust des Wertes der Verbesserungen durch physikalischen Verschleiß, funktionale Veralterung und externe Veralterung, subtrahiert im Kostenansatz.

segments.src: - **Reconciliation** — The final step where the appraiser weighs the value indications from the three approaches and states a single supported conclusion — not a mathematical average.
segments.tr: - **Abstimmung** — Der letzte Schritt, in dem der Bewerter die Wertangaben aus den drei Ansätzen gewichtet und eine einzelne gestützte Schlussfolgerung gibt — keine mathematische Durchschnitt.

segments.tr: Direkte Kapitalisierung teilt NOI durch die Kapitalisierungsquote; beachte, dass NOI vor Hypothekenzahlungen gemessen wird.

segments.src: **2 — B.** The principle of contribution says an improvement is worth what it adds to overall value, not what it cost — over-improving relative to the neighborhood rarely returns dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: **2 — B.** Der Grundsatz des Beitrags besagt, dass eine Verbesserung wert ist, was sie zum Gesamtwert hinzufügt, nicht was sie kostete — Überverbesserung relativ zur Nachbarschaft kehrt selten Dollar für Dollar zurück.

vi.title: [Bất động sản 101 #9] Bản Định Giá Thấp Hơn $20,000 — Đây là Logic Đằng Sau Con Số Đó

segments.src: > An appraisal isn't a guess about what someone might pay — it's a documented argument for what a property is most likely worth, built from three independent lines of evidence.
segments.tr: > Định giá không phải là một dự đoán về giá mà ai đó có thể trả — nó là một lập luận được tài liệu hóa về giá trị có khả năng nhất của một tài sản, được xây dựng từ ba dòng bằng chứng độc lập.

segments.src: Every real estate deal quietly runs on three different numbers that people constantly mix up:
segments.tr: Mỗi giao dịch bất động sản chạy yên tĩnh trên ba con số khác nhau mà mọi người liên tục nhầm lẫn:

segments.src: - **Cost** — what it takes to build or replace the thing.
segments.tr: - **Chi Phí** — những gì cần để xây dựng hoặc thay thế điều đó.

segments.src: - **Price** — what one specific buyer actually paid on one specific day.
segments.tr: - **Giá** — những gì một người mua cụ thể thực sự đã trả vào một ngày cụ thể.

segments.src: - **Value** — what a typical, informed buyer would most likely pay under normal conditions.
segments.tr: - **Giá Trị** — những gì một người mua bình thường, được cung cấp thông tin sẽ có khả năng trả dưới các điều kiện bình thường.

segments.src: An appraiser's job is the third one.
segments.tr: Công việc của người định giá là cái thứ ba.

segments.src: lending, "market value" has a legal definition (from the FIRREA banking rules that most lenders follow): the **most probable price** a property should bring in a competitive and open market, where buyer and seller are each typically motivated, well informed, acting in their own interest, under no duress, with the property exposed for a reasonable time, and with payment in cash or its equivalent — not distorted by unusual seller concessions.
segments.tr: cho vay, "giá trị thị trường" có định nghĩa pháp lý (từ các quy tắc ngân hàng FIRREA mà hầu hết các nhà cho vay tuân theo): **giá có khả năng nhất** mà một tài sản nên mang lại trong một thị trường cạnh tranh và mở, nơi người mua và người bán mỗi người thường được thúc đẩy, được cung cấp thông tin kỹ lưỡng, hành động theo lợi ích của họ, không bị cưỡng bức, với tài sản được tiếp xúc trong thời gian hợp lý, và thanh toán bằng tiền mặt hoặc tương đương của nó — không bị biến dạng bởi những nhượng bộ không bình thường của người bán.

segments.src: **The principles.** Appraisers reason from a small set of economic ideas.
segments.tr: **Các Nguyên Tắc.** Những người định giá lý luận từ một tập hợp nhỏ các ý tưởng kinh tế.

segments.src: - **Substitution** — a buyer won't pay more for a property than the cost of acquiring an equally desirable substitute. This is the engine underneath all three valuation approaches.
segments.tr: - **Thay Thế** — một người mua sẽ không trả nhiều hơn cho một tài sản so với chi phí mua một sản phẩm thay thế được mong muốn như nhau. Đây là động cơ bên dưới cả ba phương pháp định giá.

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — value is based on the most profitable use that is *legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive*. A 1950s bungalow on a commercially zoned corner may be appraised as land, with the house counted as nearly worthless.
segments.tr: - **Sử Dụng Cao Nhất Và Tốt Nhất** — giá trị được dựa trên việc sử dụng có lợi nhất mà *được phép hợp pháp, có thể thực hiện được về mặt vật lý, khả thi về mặt tài chính, và có năng suất cao nhất*. Một ngôi nhà bungalow thập niên 1950 trên một góc phân vùng thương mại có thể được định giá như đất, với ngôi nhà được tính là gần như không có giá trị.

segments.src: - **Anticipation** — value reflects expected *future* benefits, not past spending. Nobody pays you back for what you spent; they pay for what they expect to get.
segments.tr: - **Dự Đoán** — giá trị phản ánh các lợi ích *tương lai* dự kiến, không phải chi tiêu quá khứ. Không ai hoàn lại cho bạn những gì bạn đã chi tiêu; họ trả tiền cho những gì họ mong đợi sẽ nhận được.

segments.src: - **Contribution** — an improvement is worth what it adds to total value, not what it cost. The classic case: a $90,000 kitchen that adds $45,000.
segments.tr: - **Đóng Góp** — một cải tiến có giá trị những gì nó thêm vào tổng giá trị, không phải chi phí của nó. Trường hợp kinh điển: một nhà bếp $90,000 thêm $45,000.

segments.src: - **Conformity, change, externalities** — properties do best surrounded by similar properties, nothing stays static, and a new highway ramp or a closed hospital changes value from outside the lot line.
segments.tr: - **Sự Phù Hợp, Thay Đổi, Yếu Tố Bên Ngoài** — các tài sản hoạt động tốt nhất khi được bao quanh bởi các tài sản tương tự, không có gì ổn định, và một tuyến đường cao tốc mới hoặc một bệnh viện đóng cửa thay đổi giá trị từ bên ngoài đường lô.

segments.src: **The three approaches.** These are three separate roads to the same estimate; each is strongest for a different property type.
segments.tr: **Ba Cách Tiếp Cận.** Đây là ba con đường riêng biệt đến cùng một ước tính; mỗi cách mạnh nhất cho một loại tài sản khác.

segments.src: 1. **Sales Comparison Approach.** Find recent sales of similar properties ("comps"), then adjust each comp's *sale price* toward the subject. Rule of thumb: if the comp is better, subtract; if the comp is worse, add. Best for single-family homes and condos, where sales data is thick.
segments.tr: 1. **Phương Pháp So Sánh Bán Hàng.** Tìm các bán hàng gần đây của các tài sản tương tự ("comps"), sau đó điều chỉnh *giá bán* của mỗi comp hướng tới chủ đề. Quy tắc chung: nếu comp tốt hơn, trừ đi; nếu comp tệ hơn, thêm vào. Tốt nhất cho những ngôi nhà gia đình đơn và căn hộ, nơi dữ liệu bán hàng dày đặc.

segments.src: 2. **Cost Approach.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Depreciation comes in three flavors: **physical deterioration** (a 22-year-old roof), **functional obsolescence** (a four-bedroom house with one bathroom), and **external obsolescence** (backing onto a rail yard). Best for new construction, churches, schools, fire stations — things that rarely sell.
segments.tr: 2. **Phương Pháp Chi Phí.** `Value = Land Value + (Cost to Build New − Accrued Depreciation)`. Khấu hao có ba loại: **suy thoái vật lý** (mái nhà 22 tuổi), **lỗi thời chức năng** (một ngôi nhà bốn phòng ngủ với một phòng tắm), và **lỗi thời bên ngoài** (phía sau một bãi tàu hỏa). Tốt nhất cho xây dựng mới, nhà thờ, trường học, trạm cứu hỏa — những thứ hiếm khi bán.

segments.src: 3. **Income Capitalization Approach.** For property bought to produce income: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI is rental income minus vacancy and operating expenses — *before* mortgage payments and income taxes. Best for apartments, retail strips, warehouses.
segments.tr: 3. **Phương Pháp Tư Nhân Hóa Thu Nhập.** Đối với tài sản được mua để tạo thu nhập: `Value = Net Operating Income ÷ Capitalization Rate`. NOI là thu nhập cho thuê trừ đi tỷ lệ trống và chi phí hoạt động — *trước* thanh toán thế chấp và thuế thu nhập. Tốt nhất cho căn hộ, các dải bán lẻ, kho.

segments.src: The final step is **reconciliation**: the appraiser weights the approaches by how good the data was and what the property is, then states a single value.
segments.tr: Bước cuối cùng là **hòa giải**: người định giá cân bằng các cách tiếp cận dựa trên mức độ tốt của dữ liệu và loại tài sản, sau đó nêu ra một giá trị duy nhất.

segments.src: It is deliberately *not* an average of the three.
segments.tr: Nó cố ý *không phải* là trung bình của ba.

segments.src: Your lender will size the loan on the **lower of price or appraised value**.
segments.tr: Nhà cho vay của bạn sẽ xác định khoản vay dựa trên **con số thấp hơn giữa giá hoặc giá trị định giá**.

segments.src: That opens a **$20,000 appraisal gap**, and you have four moves: pay the gap in cash, renegotiate the price with the seller, split the difference, or walk away if your contract has an appraisal contingency.

segments.src: Under 2024 federal interagency guidance, lenders must have a process for borrowers to submit better comps or flag factual errors — a wrong square footage, a missed recent sale down the block.
segments.tr: Theo hướng dẫn liên cơ quan liên bang năm 2024, các nhà cho vay phải có quy trình cho phép người vay nộp các comps tốt hơn hoặc gắn cờ các lỗi thực tế — một diện tích không đúng, một lần bán gần đây bị bỏ sót ở gần đó.

segments.tr: Nó không phải là cuộc đàm phán về số; nó là một yêu cầu để xem xét lại bằng chứng.

segments.src: One more distinction worth carrying around: an appraisal is not your county's **assessed value** (a tax figure, often updated on a multi-year cycle), not an agent's **CMA** (a pricing opinion, not a regulated appraisal), and not a **Zestimate** or other AVM (a statistical model that has never seen the inside of the house).
segments.tr: Một sự phân biệt đáng mang theo: một bản định giá không phải giá trị được **đánh giá** của quận bạn (một con số thuế, thường được cập nhật theo chu kỳ nhiều năm), không phải **CMA** của một đại lý (ý kiến định giá, không phải một bản định giá được điều tiết), và không phải **Zestimate** hoặc AVM khác (một mô hình thống kê chưa bao giờ vào trong ngôi nhà).

segments.src: 1. Appraisal estimates *market value* — the most probable price under normal conditions — which is a different thing from cost and from one buyer's price.
segments.tr: 1. Ước tính định giá *giá trị thị trường* — giá có khả năng nhất trong các điều kiện bình thường — đó là một điều khác biệt so với chi phí và giá của một người mua.

segments.src: 2. The reasoning rests on principles like substitution, highest and best use, anticipation, and contribution — which is why what you spent never automatically equals what you get.
segments.tr: 2. Lý luận dựa trên các nguyên tắc như thay thế, sử dụng cao nhất và tốt nhất, dự đoán và đóng góp — đó là lý do tại sao những gì bạn chi tiêu không bao giờ tự động bằng những gì bạn nhận được.

segments.src: 3. Three approaches — sales comparison, cost, and income — are run and then reconciled by judgment, not averaged; homes lean on comps, income property leans on `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.
segments.tr: 3. Ba cách tiếp cận — so sánh bán hàng, chi phí và thu nhập — được chạy và sau đó được hòa giải bằng phán xét, không được tính trung bình; nhà ở dựa trên comps, tài sản thu nhập dựa trên `Value = NOI ÷ Cap Rate`.

segments.src: - **Market value** — The most probable price a property should bring in an open, competitive market with both parties informed, unpressured, and given reasonable exposure time.
segments.tr: - **Giá trị thị trường** — Giá có khả năng nhất mà một tài sản nên mang lại trên một thị trường mở, cạnh tranh với cả hai bên được thông báo, không bị ép buộc và được đưa ra thời gian tiếp xúc hợp lý.

segments.src: - **Highest and best use** — The use of a property that is legally permissible, physically possible, financially feasible, and maximally productive; the baseline assumption for any appraisal.
segments.tr: - **Sử dụng cao nhất và tốt nhất** — Việc sử dụng một tài sản được phép hợp pháp, có thể thực hiện được về mặt vật lý, khả thi về mặt tài chính, và có năng suất cao nhất; giả định cơ sở cho bất kỳ bản định giá nào.

segments.src: - **Comparable (comp)** — A recently sold, similar property whose sale price is adjusted up or down toward the subject property to indicate the subject's value.
segments.tr: - **Có thể so sánh được (comp)** — Một tài sản tương tự được bán gần đây, có giá bán được điều chỉnh lên hoặc xuống hướng tới tài sản chủ đề để cho biết giá trị của chủ đề.

segments.src: - **Capitalization rate** — The ratio of a property's net operating income to its value (`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`), used to convert income into a value estimate.
segments.tr: - **Tỷ lệ tư nhân hóa** — Tỷ lệ thu nhập hoạt động ròng của một tài sản với giá trị của nó (`Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Value`), được sử dụng để chuyển đổi thu nhập thành ước tính giá trị.

segments.src: - **Accrued depreciation** — Total loss in value of the improvements from physical deterioration, functional obsolescence, and external obsolescence, subtracted in the cost approach.
segments.tr: - **Khấu hao tích lũy** — Tổng tổn thất giá trị của các cải tiến từ suy thoái vật lý, lỗi thời chức năng và lỗi thời bên ngoài, bị trừ trong phương pháp chi phí.

segments.src: - **Reconciliation** — The final step where the appraiser weighs the value indications from the three approaches and states a single supported conclusion — not a mathematical average.
segments.tr: - **Hòa giải** — Bước cuối cùng nơi người định giá cân bằng các chỉ báo giá trị từ ba cách tiếp cận và nêu ra một kết luận được hỗ trợ duy nhất — không phải trung bình toán học.

segments.src: Direct capitalization divides NOI by the cap rate; note that NOI is measured before mortgage payments.
segments.tr: Tư nhân hóa trực tiếp chia NOI cho tỷ lệ cap; lưu ý rằng NOI được đo trước khi thanh toán thế chấp.

segments.src: **2 — B.** The principle of contribution says an improvement is worth what it adds to overall value, not what it cost — over-improving relative to the neighborhood rarely returns dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: **2 — B.** Nguyên tắc đóng góp nói rằng một cải tiến có giá trị những gì nó thêm vào tổng giá trị, không phải chi phí của nó — cải tiến quá mức so với khu lân cận hiếm khi quay trở lại dollar cho dollar.

segments.src: **3 — X (False).** Lenders size the loan against the **lower** of appraised value or contract price, which creates the $20,000 appraisal gap the buyer must cover in cash, renegotiate, or exit via an appraisal contingency.*
segments.tr: **3 — X (Sai).** Các nhà cho vay định cỡ khoản vay dựa trên **giá trị thấp hơn** giữa giá trị định giá hoặc giá hợp đồng, tạo ra khoảng cách định giá $20,000 mà người mua phải bao phủ bằng tiền mặt, đàm phán lại, hoặc thoát khỏi thông qua điều khoản định giá.*
